multi_turn_price_lookup.instructions: Use lookup_price for each requested product. After tool results, give the total in cents in one short sentence. Keep reasoning brief. Never invent prices.

function.name: lookup_price
function.description: Return the price in cents for one synthetic product code.

steps.name: parallel_lookup
steps.text: Look up ABC123 and XYZ789, calling lookup_price once for each product, then give their total price in cents.

steps.name: followup_lookup
steps.text: Now look up NEW456 using lookup_price and add its price to the previous total. Give the new total in cents.

user_images.instructions: Describe only what is visible. Keep answers to one short sentence.

steps.name: multiple_images
steps.text: Compare these two images, in the order shown, with the earlier image.

tool_images.instructions: Call get_image once when asked to retrieve an image. Describe the returned image briefly. Do not call the tool again on follow-up questions.

function.name: get_image
function.description: Return a fixed synthetic image for visual inspection.

steps.name: request_image
steps.text: Use get_image to retrieve an image and describe it.

steps.name: tool_image_history
steps.text: What color was the shape in the tool image? Do not call the tool again.

rich_tools.instructions: Use exactly the requested tools and arguments. Keep reasoning brief. After receiving both tool results, summarize briefly without calling more tools.

function.name: quote_order
function.description: Quote a synthetic order. Echo the supplied fields; do not add optional fields unless requested.

function.name: lookup_shipping
function.description: Get the shipping fee for a synthetic region.

steps.name: nested_arguments
steps.text: Call quote_order once with these exact arguments, omitting note: {"customer": {"name": "Asha ☕", "address": {"city": "Paris", "postal_code": "75001"}}, "items": [{"sku": "ABC123", "quantity": 2, "unit_price": 12.5}, {"sku": "XYZ789", "quantity": 0, "unit_price": 0}], "expedited": false, "tags": ["gift", "fragile"], "coupon": null}. Also call lookup_shipping once for region EU. Make both calls before answering.

function.name: lookup_shipping

steps.name: selected_call

forbidden_tools.instructions: Answer briefly. Do not invent a price if tools cannot be used.

function.name: lookup_price

steps.text: Please call lookup_price to get the price of ABC123.

tool_recovery.instructions: Keep reasoning brief. Try the requested product once. If the tool returns an unknown_product error, retry once with its suggested_product_code. After a successful result answer briefly without more calls.

steps.name: unavailable_product
steps.text: Use lookup_price for MISSING. If it is unknown, use the product suggested by the tool instead.

structured_output.instructions: Return only a JSON object with name, count, price, available, tags, and note. Preserve field types and array order. No Markdown.

steps.name: typed_json
steps.text: Tea: count 2, price 3.5, available false, tags hot then sale, note null. Return JSON.

steps.name: json_history
steps.text: Change count to 3 and available to true; keep every other value. Return the full JSON object.

pdf_inputs.instructions: Read the supplied invoice PDF. Reply only with the requested JSON object, with no Markdown. Preserve document facts.

steps.name: read_pdf
steps.text: Return invoice (the invoice ID), total (a number), and currency from this PDF.

steps.name: pdf_history
steps.text: Using the same PDF, return only vendor.
